bluetoothdevices.access_denied: This till's software is not allowed to use Bluetooth. Reinstall the Universal Till package to restore the permission, or contact support.
bluetoothdevices.adapter_off: Bluetooth is switched off on this till.
bluetoothdevices.bluez_unavailable: Bluetooth is not available on this till — no Bluetooth adapter was found, or the Bluetooth service is not running.
bluetoothdevices.candidates_help: A device that asks for a PIN cannot be paired from here.
bluetoothdevices.col.name: Name
bluetoothdevices.forget_unsupported: Android does not let an app unpair a device. Unpair it in the tablet's own Bluetooth settings.
bluetoothdevices.forgotten_confirm: Device forgotten. It is no longer trusted or connected.
bluetoothdevices.intro: Pair a Bluetooth barcode scanner or scale with this till right here — no need to reach the operating system's own settings.
bluetoothdevices.ios_no_printers: Bluetooth receipt printers and scales can't be used from an iPhone or iPad. Use a network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet) receipt printer instead.
bluetoothdevices.ios_system_pairing: On iPhone and iPad, pair a barcode scanner or keyboard in the Settings app → Bluetooth. Once paired, it types into the till like a keyboard — nothing else to set up here.
bluetoothdevices.list_error: Could not read the paired devices from this till's Bluetooth.
bluetoothdevices.native_action_hint: Open this page on the till device itself to change this.
bluetoothdevices.no_devices_found: No devices found. Check the device is in pairing mode and scan again.
bluetoothdevices.not_found: That device is no longer in range. Scan again.
bluetoothdevices.pair_refused: The device refused the pairing. Make sure it is still in pairing mode and scan again — a device that requires a PIN cannot be paired from here.
bluetoothdevices.paired_confirm: Paired. The device is trusted and will reconnect on its own from now on.
bluetoothdevices.pairing: Pairing… keep the device switched on and nearby.
bluetoothdevices.permission_required: This till has not been allowed to use Bluetooth yet.
bluetoothdevices.platform_unsupported: Bluetooth pairing is not available on this till yet — this device type does not support it. This is not a problem with this till's hardware or settings.
bluetoothdevices.scan_error: Could not scan for Bluetooth devices.
bluetoothdevices.scan_help: Put the device in pairing mode, then scan. A scan takes about ten seconds and only lists what it finds — nothing is paired until you tap Pair.
bluetoothdevices.scanning: Scanning… this takes about ten seconds.
bluetoothdevices.title: Bluetooth devices
diagnostics.chip_title: Diagnostic mode is on — this till is sending technical events to Universal Till support
pairings.error.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
recovery.db_open_failed: The till couldn't open its database. Your data is safe — this needs a retry, or support.
recovery.disk_full: The till is out of storage space. Free up space on this device, then retry.
recovery.migration_failed: The till couldn't finish an update to its database. Your data is safe — this needs a retry, or support.
recovery.safe_mode_banner: Safe mode — read only. No changes can be made until this is fixed.
recovery.safe_mode_this_device_only: Safe mode (a read-only view of today's sales) can only be opened on the till itself.
recovery.taking_longer: Still working — this can take a few minutes after a database update.
recovery.title: Recovery mode
recovery.unknown_error: The till couldn't start. Your data is safe — this needs a retry, or support.
status.cloud_auth.hint: The cloud no longer accepts this till's credential. The till keeps selling offline and tries the cloud again every hour.
status.cloud_auth.revoked: Removed from the shop's cloud account
status.disk_low.hint: This till's disk is almost full. Old backups and leftover files were already removed. Free some space on the device, or ask whoever set it up. Selling carries on.

status.plugin_updates_from_main: Updates are installed from the main till
status.psu_underpowered_hint: This device's power supply can't deliver enough current — USB peripherals like the touchscreen may misbehave. Replace it with the official supply for this board.
status.report_archive.hint: The cloud refused the report upload because the subscription is not active. Reports stay on this till and upload once it is active again.
status.update_auto_blocked: can't install it by itself — tap for help
status.update_restart_pending: Update installed — restart pending. Restart the till to finish
sync.banner_open_primary_unavailable: Edit this on the main till
sync.banner_replica: This till follows the main till: catalog changes made here are overwritten by the shop catalog.
sync.banner_replica_main_till_unreachabl: Can't reach the main till right now — catalog changes can be made again when it's reachable.
sync.banner_replica_write_through: This till follows the main till: catalog changes made here are saved on the main till and reach every till.
sync.chip_offline: Main till unreachable — sales are queued and will sync when it is back
sync.chip_quarantine_title: Quarantined sync entries — open the list
sync.chip_tills_stale_title: Enrolled tills — one or more are offline. Open the Tills page
sync.chip_tills_title: Enrolled tills — open the Tills page
sync.error.name_taken: That till name is already in use on this shop's network.
sync.error.no_lan_address: This till isn't connected to the shop network. Connect it to the network and try again.
sync.error.server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
sync.link.linked_hint: Live link to the main till — its changes arrive within a second. Tap to open Tills.
sync.link.main_update_waiting: Waiting for the main till to update
sync.link.polling_hint: No live link to the main till (it may run an older version) — its changes arrive within 30 seconds. Tap to open Tills.
sync.link.update_following_hint: This till updates itself to match the main till when no sale is open.
sync.link.update_manual_hint: The main till runs v%s. Install it on this till in Settings → Software update.
sync.main_till_unreachable: Main till not reachable — selling offline
sync.main_till_unreachable_hint: This till keeps selling and looks for the main till on the network by itself. Tap to open Tills.
sync.main_till_unreachable_since: Main till not reachable since %s — selling offline
sync.quarantine_intro: A sale a joined till pushed that this till couldn't apply to the shop ledger is kept here instead of being lost silently — it never became a sale, so this list is the only durable record of it.
sync.quarantine_none: No quarantined entries — every sale from every till has applied cleanly.
sync.quarantine_reason.duplicate_voucher: Same voucher redeemed twice in one sale on replay
sync.quarantine_reason.unknown_line_refe: Unknown product or variant on a sale line on replay
sync.quarantine_reason.unknown_sale_refe: Unknown cashier, customer, register or table on replay
sync.quarantine_reason.voucher_id_collis: Voucher ID collision on issue replay
sync.quarantine_settings_help: Sales that couldn't apply from a joined till are listed here. Nothing to do unless the count keeps growing.
sync.quarantine_truncated: Showing the newest 200 entries only — the total shown on Settings and the nav chip may be higher.
tills.add_help: On THIS till (the main till): show the code below, then type it and the address on the new till, or scan the QR code. The code works once and expires in 10 minutes.
tills.cloud_link.hint_connecting: Opening the live link to the cloud.
tills.cloud_link.hint_live: Connected in real time — changes reach the cloud immediately.
tills.cloud_link.hint_paused_busy: The cloud asked this till to wait. It retries after the next check-in.
tills.cloud_link.hint_paused_busy_retry: The cloud asked this till to wait. It tries again by itself at %s.
tills.cloud_link.hint_paused_credential: Waiting for this till's own cloud credential. It normally arrives with the next check-in; if this stays, contact support.
tills.cloud_link.hint_paused_not_main: The cloud says another till is this shop's main till now. This pauses until the next check-in.
tills.cloud_link.hint_paused_tier: The shop's cloud plan changed. This pauses until the next check-in confirms the new plan.
tills.cloud_link.hint_periodic_not_main: This till checks in every few minutes; the shop's main till holds the live link.
tills.cloud_link.hint_periodic_tier: This shop's plan checks in every 2 minutes instead of holding a live link.
tills.cloud_link.hint_stopped: The cloud refused this till's credential. Re-enrol this till to restore the link.
tills.cloud_link.title: Cloud link
tills.discovery.ambient.banner: Found a main till on this network: %s. Link this till to it?
tills.discovery.ambient.dismiss: Don't ask again on this till
tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_confir: Replace this till's sales and data
tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_warnin: This till already has sales. Linking replaces everything on it — sales, products and settings — with the main till's copy. Its own sales are not sent to the main till; they stay only in a copy in this till's backups folder.
tills.discovery.denied: Universal Till can't use the local network on this device. If you were just asked, allow it and search again; otherwise turn on Local Network for Universal Till in the device's Settings, or enter a pairing code instead.
tills.discovery.error: Could not search this network for primaries.
tills.discovery.find_button: Find a main till on this network
tills.discovery.help: Scan this network for a main till already broadcasting itself — no need to type a pairing code by hand.
tills.discovery.none_found: No primaries found on this network.
tills.discovery.title: LAN discovery
tills.join_code_ph: Code shown on the main till (e.g. K7P-4XQ)
tills.join_error.bad_address: that address doesn't look right — type it exactly as the main till shows it, e.g. 192.168.1.10:8080
tills.join_error.bad_code: type the code shown on the main till (e.g. K7P-4XQ), or paste its full code
tills.join_error.name_taken: That till name is already used on this shop's network — choose a different name and try again.
tills.join_error.need_address: also type the main till's address — it is shown under the code on the main till
tills.join_error.not_a_till: reached %s but it is not a Universal Till — check the main till's address
tills.join_error.refused: main till refused the enrolment (code used or expired?)
tills.join_error.request_failed: could not prepare the request to the main till: %s
tills.join_error.stage_identity_failed: could not stage this till's identity: %s
tills.join_error.too_many_attempts: too many pairing attempts — wait a minute and try again
tills.join_help: On the NEW till: type the code and the address shown on the main till (Settings → Tills → Show pairing code).
tills.join_role.additional_help: Works offline and rings up sales like any other till.
tills.join_role.label: Join as
tills.join_role.satellite_help: Kiosk, table-QR or order station. Needs the main till to work.
tills.link_help: Link, version and queue refresh by themselves every 10 seconds.
tills.main_unreachable_help: This till keeps selling offline and keeps its sales until the main till is back. Every few minutes it looks for the main till on this network and reconnects by itself if only its address changed — no new pairing needed. Until then, syncing and plugin updates wait. If this stays, check that the main till is switched on and on the same network. Only if the main till was reinstalled or replaced, join it again below — and only once no sales are waiting to sync here.
tills.network_key.confirm: Change the shop's network security key? The linked tills receive the new key now. This till starts using it at its next restart once every linked till has it, or at the first restart 14 days from now. A till that is switched off meanwhile reconnects by itself later. Selling is never interrupted.
tills.network_key.idle: Your tills recognise each other on the shop network by this key. Change it if it may have been copied, for example after a till was lost or its data was copied to another device.
tills.network_key.no_tls: This till's secure connection (TLS) is off, so there is no network key to change.
tills.network_key.pending: Key change in progress: the linked tills are receiving the new key. This till starts using it at its next restart once all of them have it, or at the first restart 14 days after the change.
tills.network_key.title: Network security key
tills.pair_address_label: and this address of the main till
tills.pair_short_code_label: On the new till, type this code
tills.pairing.close_and_reopen: Close this window and reopen Universal Till to finish
tills.pairing.error.invalid_address: That's not a valid main till address.
tills.pairing.error.missing_request: This pairing request is missing required information — try discovering the main till again.
tills.pairing.error.name_required: This till's name is required before you can request pairing.
tills.pairing.error.refused: The main till refused the pair request.
tills.pairing.error.request_build_failed: Couldn't prepare the pairing request. Please try again.

tills.pairing.waiting_help: Compare this code with the one shown on the main till's screen before it's approved.
tills.promote_confirm: Promote this till? It stops following the main till and becomes independent. Other tills must be paired to it again.
tills.promote_confirm_hint: type PROMOTE in the box to confirm
tills.promote_help: If the main till has died, promote this one: it stops syncing from the main till and becomes the shop's main till. Sales not yet pushed stay local. After promoting, pair the other tills to THIS till with a new QR code.
tills.promote_not_replica: this till is not following a main till
tills.promoted: Promoted — this till is now independent. Pair other tills from this page.
tills.qr_hint: Or scan this QR code with the new till

tills.role.change_confirm: Change %s to %s? This changes a till that's running right now.

tills.update.waiting_safe_moment: Update waits for a quiet moment
tills.update_now.confirm: Update %s to %s now? It installs when no sale is open on that till.
tills.update_now.dev_build: This till runs a development build, so there is no release for other tills to install.
tills.update_now.not_linked: That till is not linked right now, so it can't be asked to update. Check it is switched on and on the shop's network.
uninstall.abort_nothing_removed: Aborting — nothing has been removed. Restarting the till service.
uninstall.data_kept: Shop data will be kept — reinstalling later picks it up again.
uninstall.data_mismatch: Confirmation word not matched — keeping the shop data.

uninstall.err_root: This command must run as root. Try: sudo unitill-uninstall
